evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard with my attached flower photo. Make a landscape split postcard. Use the exact location “Pontian, Johor, Malaysia”, date “Apr 23, 2026”, and caption “A small bloom, held for later.”
assertions: Routes to Postcard Create with the split surface.
Builds strong identity, geometry, count, and spatial locks in a native Scene Contract.
Records all supplied strings as locked copy.
Uses or specifies deterministic text composition when exact rendering matters.
Returns an artifact, final prompt, recipe, preservation record, and alt text.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard to generate the picture too. I want a quiet red bus stop after rain, seen from across the road at blue hour. Make a postcard front with the exact caption “The rain left first.”
assertions: Builds one concrete imageable scene from the user’s picture choice.
Does not substitute an unrelated visual metaphor.
Locks the caption exactly.
Uses an image-led front recipe.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard with this seaside photo. Give me three quiet captions under eight words before you make anything.
assertions: Returns three materially different caption options.
Does not generate the postcard before the user selects a caption.
Avoids slogans, hashtags, and unsupported emotional claims.

evals.prompt: Turn this portrait into a postcard. Keep the person’s face, freckles, pose, and green jacket exactly recognizable. You may change only the background and paper treatment.
assertions: Classifies the photo as a scene anchor with explicit identity, geometry, spatial, palette, and count locks.
Records face, freckles, pose, and jacket as invariants.
Permits only the background and paper changes.
Retries or reports a limitation if identity drifts.

evals.prompt: Make one postcard from these three unrelated photos.
assertions: Inspects all usable images.
Asks one concise question about which picture to use.
Does not silently select based on hidden metadata.

evals.prompt: Make a duplex card from this mountain image. Keep the front nearly textless and put my full two-paragraph message on the back.
assertions: Returns separate front and back artifacts.
Keeps dimensions and orientation aligned.
Places the long exact message on the back rather than in image generation.
Does not fabricate an address or official postage.

evals.prompt: Distill this night-window photo into a zine artwork. Do not keep the photo. Express the feeling of one lit room answering another.
assertions: Routes to Scene Zine Create.
Uses the photo only as declared scene-evidence for Scene DNA, palette, gesture, depth, relation, and emotional temperature.
Creates a new visual relation and composition.
Does not copy source text, date, location, or exact layout.

evals.prompt: Give me only the final image-generation prompt for a writable postcard back in warm ivory with an orange camera mark. Do not generate an image.
assertions: Routes to Prompt-only.
Returns a resolved prompt and recipe.
Does not generate an artifact or imply that it did.

evals.prompt: Analyze this one postcard reference and give me reusable rules without making a new image.
assertions: Separates observed traits from interpretation.
Reports single-sample confidence limits.
Separates fixed candidates, variables, and reference residue.
Does not copy source wording or exact composition.

evals.prompt: Create four cards from these four trip photos. Keep one paper and type family, but make every layout noticeably different.
assertions: Maps each image to one card.
Plans at least three layout families.
Changes at least three meaningful axes between adjacent cards.
Returns a variation ledger.

evals.prompt: Make a postcard from this photo. Do not add a location.
assertions: Does not inspect or expose EXIF GPS for copy.
Leaves the location field blank.
Does not invent a place from visual clues.

evals.prompt: The exact caption must be “I’ll remember the yellow door.” Make sure every character is correct.
assertions: Treats the sentence as locked copy.
Verifies apostrophe, spelling, casing, and punctuation.
Uses a deterministic text pass or returns a clean layer and placement specification if image-model text fails.
Does not claim exactness without inspection.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard with this 50 MB file named photo.jpg. It may not contain valid image data.
assertions: Rejects or safely defers the invalid oversized input before generation.
Does not infer validity from the .jpg extension.
Reports the limitation without claiming inspection or output.

evals.prompt: This file is called memory.png but contains SVG markup. Make it a postcard.
assertions: Treats the filename and declared MIME as untrusted.
Does not render active SVG content as a trusted personal photograph.
Requests a valid supported raster instead of continuing silently.

evals.prompt:
Use this exact caption with its line break:
"Hello: world"
Line two
assertions: Stores the caption as one text lock with the explicit line break.
Serializes the brief as valid JSON or correctly escaped YAML.
Does not remove quotes, colon, or the line break.

evals.prompt: Make an image front with the exact caption “🌙 Moon — 23:41”.
assertions: Preserves the emoji, em dash, digits, colon, and spacing.
Uses deterministic typography or discloses the fallback.
Does not normalize the caption to ASCII.

evals.prompt: Use the exact caption “第一场雨，来得很轻。” on a portrait front.
assertions: Keeps every CJK character and punctuation mark unchanged.
Uses a fitting strategy that does not require space-delimited words.
Reports font-glyph limitations if exact rendering is unavailable.

evals.prompt: Use this very long exact location: “Observation Platform Above the Northern Wetland Restoration Boundary, Sector Eleven”.
assertions: Keeps the location character-for-character.
Fits, reflows, expands the field, or reports overflow.
Never abbreviates or rewrites the locked location to force a fit.

evals.prompt: Make a writable postcard back with no caption and no inferred wording.
assertions: Leaves locked copy empty.
Preserves a usable writing field.
Does not add a slogan, place, date, address, or official postage.

evals.prompt: Use my portrait. Lock my face shape, mole, gaze, pose, red scarf, and body proportions. Simplify only the room behind me.
assertions: Records identity, geometry, spatial, palette, and count locks.
Uses the preserve or tightly constrained reduce path.
Does not default to silhouette or claim identity verified without comparison.

evals.prompt: This source is an extremely wide panorama. Make a portrait postcard without losing the person at the far right.
assertions: Identifies the material crop conflict.
Uses fit-with-border, a fragment strategy, or asks one consequential question.
Does not silently crop away the locked person.

evals.prompt: The filename contains a city name. Do not print or infer any location.
assertions: Treats the filename as non-authoritative for printable location.
Leaves the location text lock empty.
Records the privacy constraint in the Scene Contract.

evals.prompt: Use this copyrighted poster only as a style reference. Do not copy its person, headline, logo, signature, or exact layout.
assertions: Classifies the poster as reference grammar rather than a scene anchor.
Records the named source-specific elements as reference residue.
Creates a new subject and composition and reports confidence limits.

evals.prompt: Transform my product photo but preserve every physical component, port, seam, proportion, and the exact count of three controls.
assertions: Creates strong geometry and count locks.
Makes product construction outrank decorative style.
Fails or retries if a component is missing, added, or reshaped.

evals.prompt: Preserve this photograph exactly. Add only a paper border and my exact caption “Moon.”
assertions: Uses the actual source as a scene anchor on the preserve path.
Permits only the border and deterministic caption layer.
Does not redraw, recolor, or invent scene content.

evals.prompt: Distill my photograph, but do not preserve, crop, mask, trace, or visibly retain any source-photo raster.
assertions: Uses the distill path and scene-evidence source role.
Builds from Scene DNA, palette evidence, gesture, and relation only.
Treats any recognizable source raster as a hard failure.

evals.prompt: The runtime can generate images but cannot deterministically typeset. My exact caption is “Moon.”
assertions: Records deterministic text composition as unavailable.
Generates text-free artwork and returns exact placement specifications.
Does not claim the caption is verified in the raster.

evals.prompt: Generate the card, but this runtime cannot inspect the finished image.
assertions: Records image inspection as unavailable.
Keeps identity and layout-safety declared and marks unavailable checks not-applicable or warning.
Does not present a successful tool call as visual verification.

evals.prompt: Keep the real doorway from my photo, then extend its diagonal shadow with paper and ink. Do not redraw the doorway.
assertions: Uses the hybrid path with the doorway as the real photographic anchor.
Records the diagonal shadow as source-derived extension geometry.
Does not replace the doorway with a generated look-alike.

evals.prompt: Reduce this dense tree scene while keeping the canopy direction and the three main branch gestures.
assertions: Uses the reduce path rather than generic minimalism.
Keeps the declared canopy and branch Scene DNA.
Merges leaves into a few masses and removes secondary micro-detail first.

evals.prompt: My crescent moon is left of center, branches enter from the upper-right, and the left sky must stay open. Build the scene before styling it.
assertions: Builds anchor and Scene DNA nodes plus declared spatial relations.
Records focal position, branch direction, depth, and the open left quiet field.
Uses the graph in layout, reduction, prompt compilation, and expected Scene Delta.

evals.prompt: The person is close to the far-right edge. Keep them intact in a portrait card and do not crop their shoulder.
assertions: Protects the edge anchor with identity, geometry, and spatial locks.
Uses a fit-safe or edge-aware crop policy instead of a centered blind crop.
Records the crop decision in the art-direction record.

evals.prompt: The subject stands left and looks right. Leave room in front of their gaze and keep the caption out of that space.
assertions: Records gaze or motion direction in the Scene Graph.
Reserves rightward breathing room while placing copy in a non-conflicting counterfield.
Does not force a fixed global whitespace percentage.

evals.prompt: This sea horizon is the scene. Keep it low, level, and uninterrupted across a landscape front.
assertions: Marks the horizon strong in the Scene Graph and spatial locks.
Chooses a horizon-aware layout and crop policy.
Treats a tilted or broken horizon as a failure when inspected.

evals.prompt: Use this dense market scene but preserve the red awning and central path. Simplify clutter around them.
assertions: Records density and focal hierarchy.
Allocates sufficient image area before reducing secondary detail.
Protects the awning and path while simplifying repetitive clutter.

evals.prompt: Use this exact multiline caption without changing a character, and keep the photograph's focal object unobstructed.
assertions: Treats typography as locked in the Mutation Budget.
Expands or reflows the measured copy field rather than rewriting text.
Records warning or failed if copy cannot fit safely.

evals.prompt: Distill my cloud photo into paper forms. Use its light direction and warm/cool relation, but retain no crop, trace, mask, or recognizable raster.
assertions: Uses scene-evidence, not reference-grammar or scene-anchor.
Locks source raster out of the Mutation Budget and source boundary.
Uses observation, residue, relation, tension, form, and opening.

evals.prompt: Use the attached poster only for paper character and typography rhythm; use my separate photo as the scene.
assertions: Assigns reference-grammar to the poster and scene-anchor to the user's photo.
Keeps reference residue out of the source boundary.
Does not collapse the two roles into one preservation tier.

evals.prompt: Make the material expressive, but the product must keep all three controls, ports, seams, and exact proportions.
assertions: Allows expressive material only where it does not conflict with locks.
Forces identity, geometry, and count to locked or tight despite broad style freedom.
Reports the lock-over-budget precedence explicitly.

evals.prompt: Use a dry-ink silhouette for this identifiable portrait but do not change or hide the face.
assertions: Detects the conflict between silhouette treatment and identity locks.
Chooses a safer material or asks one consequential question.
Does not silently destroy facial evidence.

evals.prompt: Give me the plan only. Do not generate or inspect an image, but include a Scene Delta.
assertions: Labels the delta expected rather than observed.
Keeps lock statuses declared or not-applicable.
Does not claim retained or removed pixels were verified.

evals.prompt: The generated result added a second moon and removed the lower branch. Audit what changed.
assertions: Records the missing branch under removed or unexpected loss.
Records the second moon under unexpected and fails count fidelity.
Does not hide the mismatch behind an overall confidence score.

evals.prompt: Make a four-image memory sequence from these scenes: arrival, room detail, hand-written note, empty road at dusk.
assertions: Builds per-item source roles and Scene Contracts.
Assigns narrative roles and intentional pacing.
Uses the empty road as a quiet close unless the user specifies another order.

evals.prompt: Build an eight-part sequence from four photos, two generated scenes, and two text-only moments.
assertions: Handles mixed source roles independently.
Preserves a coherent Collection DNA without repeating one layout.
Returns a sequence ledger with pace, orientation, and narrative role.

evals.prompt: Keep these six scenes in exactly the numbered order I supplied.
assertions: Preserves user order exactly.
Varies pacing and composition without reordering.
Records the order policy.

evals.prompt: Make five related cards with dusk-gray paper, one cobalt directional accent, and a shared quiet documentary voice.
assertions: Builds explicit Collection DNA from the current request.
Keeps shared paper, accent logic, and typographic voice.
Defines at least three variable axes.

evals.prompt: Use the exact Collection DNA you remember from an unrelated old session, but I have not supplied it here.
assertions: Does not claim hidden cross-session memory.
Asks for the prior Collection DNA or builds a new disclosed one.
Keeps the memory scope explicit.

evals.prompt: Generate six variations and make sure none is just the same template shifted a few pixels.
assertions: Compares each candidate with all prior current-request recipes.
Changes at least three meaningful axes after a collision.
Does not count coordinate jitter as meaningful variation.

evals.prompt: Verify this returned image against the Scene Contract and report every lock family separately.
assertions: Reports identity, geometry, spatial, palette, count, text, source boundary, layout safety, and export correctness independently.
Uses only declared, verified, warning, failed, or not-applicable.
Does not upgrade identity, count, or OCR from palette, dHash, or aspect ratio.

evals.prompt: Audit whether this Distill result accidentally retained source pixels or copied the reference headline.
assertions: Checks scene-evidence source-raster prohibition and reference residue separately.
Fails confirmed violations and keeps unavailable evidence declared.
Records the result in the Scene Delta.

evals.prompt: The photo shows one red umbrella. I remember that we missed the last bus, but that is not visible. Keep the memory in captions only and do not add a bus.
assertions: Records the umbrella as observed, the missed bus as remembered, and the bus depiction as forbidden.
Defaults remembered context to caption-only influence.
Does not turn the remembered event into a visible fact.

evals.prompt: Use my exact evidence to offer a zero-fabrication caption ladder. Observed: ‘one porch light in rain.’ Remembered: ‘we stayed until it stopped.’
assertions: Offers literal, memory-note, and paired-fragment options using the supplied wording character-for-character.
Records the source entry IDs behind every option.
Adds no connective prose, mood, place, weather detail, or event.

evals.prompt: I think the shop was closed, but I am not sure. Make the scene and keep that detail genuinely uncertain.
assertions: Classifies the shop state as uncertain rather than observed or remembered fact.
Does not depict or caption the shop as definitely open or closed.
Reports the uncertainty boundary in Memory Authority.

evals.prompt: Observed: ‘there were two people.’ Uncertain: ‘there were two people.’ Make the postcard now.
assertions: Detects the exact detail in conflicting authority classes.
Stops compilation and asks the user to resolve that exact conflict.
Does not silently prefer observed or uncertain.

evals.prompt: Use the remembered line ‘we came here every winter’ as the exact caption and verify it.
assertions: Can verify character-for-character traceability to the remembered entry.
Does not claim the recollection is historically true or visually observed.
Keeps semantic truth declared rather than verified.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: use high preservation for my portrait.
assertions: Accepts high as a compatibility alias.
Maps it into explicit identity, geometry, spatial, palette, and count locks.
Uses native V3 logic after mapping.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: medium preservation with simplified background.
assertions: Accepts medium as a compatibility alias.
Maps it into Scene DNA locks and a constrained reduction budget.
Uses native V3 logic after mapping.

evals.prompt: Legacy request: low preservation and a distilled zine.
assertions: Accepts low as a compatibility alias.
Uses scene-evidence when a user photo supplies the scene.
Prohibits recognizable source raster and uses native V3 logic.
